Commentary.Commentary: Tamim Iqbal is handed over the trophy and he calls the other team members to join him. Right then! That is it from this one-sided affair! Bangladesh has all the momentum as we now head to red-ball cricket. The two-match series will commence on Thursday, 31st March and Day 1 of the first Test between Bangladesh and South Africa will begin at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). But as usual, the build-up will begin much earlier. Do join us for the same. Till then, it is goodbye from this side.

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that he is a very proud man right now and is very happy that a fast bowler has won the player of the match as well as the series. He thanks all the coaching staff for working hard with their pace bowlers. Tells that this is a massive win for them and certainly one of the best moments in their cricketing history. Mentions that they take a lot of pride in playing ODI cricket and have defeated almost all the teams in this format. Applauds Shakib Al Hasan for staying in South Africa in spite of his family being hospitalized back in Bangladesh. Says that the fans have been amazing and they are surely their team's 12th man. He hopes that his side plays well in Test cricket as well.

Temba Bavuma. the losing skipper of South Africa, says Bangladesh were better in all departments and they showed that in the series. Adds, they have to go back to the drawing board and do their work. Tells that their intensity in the India series was very good but against Bangladesh, it was nowhere near good. Mentions that the individuals have to ask questions to themselves if the Indian T20 League distracted them and should not give that as an excuse. Admits that they need points to qualify for the World Cup and rather than taking steps forward after beating India, they took a couple of steps backward and hopes to come back stronger in the next series.

TASKIN AHMED IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH AS WELL AS THE SERIES. He says that he is very happy and proud that they won the series and tells, it is also his first player of the series award. Adds that he has been following the process for the last couple of years and it is working for him. Tells that he likes to follow his process by keeping things simple. Mentions that he has been working hard on his length since the time he landed in South Africa.
... Stay tuned for the presentation ...

Honestly, nothing to write for the home team. After that horrific batting performance, the bowlers did not create many chances. Apart from the wicket of Liton Das, there was a dropped catch on the very first over but after that, it was all flat. Kagiso Rabada, South Africa's premier bowler, was taken to cleaners by Tamim Iqbal, while there was nothing much from others as well. It was a day to forget for South Africa. It was a bad toss to win for Temba Bavuma.

It looked like South Africa did not arrive for the decider. They were defeated in all departments. It was the bowlers who put on a show, the hero of the hour, Taskin Ahmed bowled probing lengths and the Proteas had no answers for him. South Africa were bundled out for 154 and their batters had all the momentum with them. Das and Tamim Iqbal had a composed start and once they found the groove, both started to hit boundaries at will. Tamim Iqbal brought up his fifty in quick time while Das complemented him nicely, he failed to reach the landmark but did all the job for his team. Shakib Al Hasan came and played around to take his team home. A fantastic day, a fantastic performance and a fantastic series for Bangladesh as they win the ODI series 2-1.

HISTORY HAS BEEN CREATED! The Bangla Tigers have roared on the African desert...Bangladesh win their first ever ODI series against South Africa in South Africa. The crowd erupts at the SuperSport Park and there will be huge celebrations happening in the Bangladesh camp. They have totally outclassed the hosts here and the celebrations will go on for a long, long time.

FOUR! There it is! Bangladesh have done it! Shakib Al Hasan seals the deal for his side in style. This was a back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and cuts it hard past the point fielder for a boundary. Bangladesh win by 9 wickets!
Wide! This is a wayward ball, down leg. Shakib Al Hasan misses his nudge on the leg side and the umpire signals wide.
This is a good-length ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan keeps it out.
Back of a length, just outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to cut but it goes off the underedge and onto the deck.
On a length and around off. Tamim Iqbal opens the face of his bat and taps it to backward point.
Back of a length, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it around the corner and settles for a run.
Short and wide, outside off. Tamim Iqbal steers it to third man for a run. 150 comes up for Bangladesh.
Back of a length, around middle. Tamim Iqbal stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan prods and just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a single.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Tamim Iqbal checks his drive in the end as he gets deceived by the change of pace. A single taken as the ball goes towards deep cover.
FOUR! Rabada errs in line and serves a length ball, around leg. Shakib Al Hasan tickles it fine through the fine leg region for a boundary. Bangladesh are just 8 runs away from a historic win now.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to push it through cover but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid on.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan misses his flick and gets hit high on his pad.
On a length, just outside off. Shakib Al Hasan prods and keeps it out.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and defends it to cover.
Back of a length, around off. Tamim Iqbal taps it to point and takes off for a single.
Full and around leg. Tamim Iqbal paddles it towards fine leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Floated, full and outside off. Tamim Iqbal goes inside-out over cover and bags a boundary.
Flatter ball, on a length and spinning away late. Tamim Iqbal waits for the ball to turn and taps it to point. Four dots in a row.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Tamim Iqbal gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, full and outside off. Tamim prods to push it through cover but it goes off the outer half of the bat towards point.
Flatter ball, on middle. Tamim Iqbal gets back and tucks it to square leg.
A slider, around off. Shakib tries to steer it down but cannot get past first slip. Bangladesh are three big hits away.
Shorter and on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off. Shakib Al Hasan skips down and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Al Hasan leans and defends it.
Angles a length ball, on middle. Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket for one more.
A loopy ball, on off. Shakib punches it through covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Iqbal miscues his cut to covers.
Flatter and on off, punched to covers for one more.
Darted on the pads. Shakib helps it away to the fine leg region for a couple of runs.
This one stays low, around off. Shakib defends it very late.
Short and around off. Al Hasan cuts it to deep point for a brace.
Fuller and on off, pushed to covers.
Full and outside off. Al Hasan steps across and wrists it to long on for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! A consolation wicket for South Africa! Tossed up, full and on off. Das tries to go inside-out but does not get the required elevation. Hits it straight to Bavuma at covers. End of a brilliant innings from Das and looks like he has almost taken his side over the line. Something to cheer for the Proteas!
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: This time Das finds the gap as he cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, cut away straight to point.
Very full and on off. Iqbal reverse paddles it to short third man for a single.
Fuller ball, and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Floated, full and outside off. Das prods and pushes it to the cover fielder. 31 runs needed now off 180 balls.

FOUR! Nicely done! Excellent timing from Das! This is darted on the pads. Das rocks back and wrists it behind square on the leg side. Lungi Ngidi dives to his right at backward square leg but the ball goes past him and into the fence.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Liton Das rocks back and cuts it straight to the cover-point fielder.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal gets low in his crease and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on middle. Liton Das works it to long on for one run.
Full and outside off. Tamim Iqbal chips it towards deep cover and rotates the strike.
Floated, on a length, around off. Liton Das blocks it off the front foot. 38 runs needed off 186 balls.
Tossed up, around off. Liton Das keeps it out watchfully.
Short and outside off. Das cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! That is a top shot from Das! It wasn't that short, around middle. Das is quick to get back in his crease. He smashes it through the mid-wicket region and bags another boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Das works it to mid on.
FOUR! Shorter in length, around off. Das goes deep in his crease and cuts it late behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Drinks! 48 runs needed in 192 balls. Bangladesh are rollicking through and there are no hopes for South Africa. Their faces say it all, they are an unhappy bunch of players at the moment.
Das advances down the track and flicks it to square leg for a run. He will retain the strike.
Full and around off. Das wrists it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, shorter in length, around off. Tamim Iqbal punches it to long off and hands the strike back to Das.
Floated, full and on middle. Tamim Iqbal sweeps it wide of the deep square leg fielder for a brace.
Around off, blocked out.

FOUR! Shouts of catch it but Miller at long off does not grab it and the ball goes past the ropes. Tossed up, around off. Tamim Iqbal skips down and mistimes his slog to the left of the long off fielder. Miller runs across to his left, puts in a slide but he fails to stop the ball. A boundary. 100 comes up for Bangladesh!
Full and outside off. Liton Das drives it without much timing towards mid off.
This is a length ball, around off. Liton Das gets forward and blocks it.
Back of a length, on middle. Tamim Iqbal tickles it to fine leg and takes a run.
FOUR! That made a cracking sound off the bat! A half-volley from Dwaine Pretorius just outside off. Tamim leans and plays a cracking off-drive to bag a boundary.
A slower ball, full and on middle. Tamim wrists it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! A length ball, around off from Pretorius. Tamim Iqbal skips down and whacks it over mid on for a boundary. It is all Bangladesh at the moment!
Shamsi tosses it up, outside off. Tamim Iqbal drives it to deep cover and takes a single.
Full and on middle. Das gets forward and works it to long on for a single.
A loopy ball, on off. Liton Das defends it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Tamim Iqbal sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Rabada in the deep does well to dive to his right and keep it to just one.
Flighted ball, outside off. Tamim skips down and chops it over extra cover for a couple of runs. David Miller cuts it out from long off.
FOUR! Swept away! Full and on middle. Tamim Iqbal kneels and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Full ball, outside off. Das drops it to point.
A fuller ball, on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Length ball, on off. Das guides it nicely through point for another boundary.
Length and on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! A length ball, outside off, the ball juts holds on the surface. Das looks to push but it goes off the thick outside edge through cover-point for a boundary.
Fifty for Tamim Iqbal! All going according to the plan for the skipper and he is leading the troops well. This is full and on middle. Iqbal wrists it to mid-wicket for a single.
A single to end the over! Tossed up, around off. Iqbal hits it to point for one.
Fuller this time, on off. Iqbal pushes it back to Shamsi.
Flatter, on a length and outside off. Blocked out.
Around off, pushed to covers.
A bit of mix-up but no harm done! Slides a full ball, down the leg side. Iqbal is ball watching as he paddles this away. Das wanted a single but was sent back.
A flighted ball, on off. Iqbal defends on the front foot.
Slants a full ball, on middle. Tamim with an easy single as he nudges it around the corner.
Angles it on the pads, tucked away to square leg for a single.
Tad shorter and angling down. Iqbal paddles it to short fine leg for one more.
A loopy ball, on off. Das pushes it through extra cover for an easy single.
Tossed up, slower through the air and on off. Blocked out.
Very full and on off, this is worked to long on for a single.
Angles it around middle. Iqbal shuffles across and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Wide! Shamsi tries to target the pads but the ball turns away and Das misses his flick.
Around off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Flatter and on off. Iqbal leans and defends.
Slightly short and on off. Iqbal punches off the back foot to wide of long off for a couple of runs. A direct-hit at the striker's end but Iqbal was well in.
Tossed up, full and turning away. Iqbal taps it to point.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack.
Very full and on off. Das can't hit it past the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on off. Das prods and keeps it out.
Flatter and on off. Iqbal rocks back and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, on off. Iqbal reverse sweeps it but straight to the fielder at point.
Tossed up, on off. Das pushes it gently to point for a single.
Fuller and on off. Das defends it to point.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, South Africa can field a maximum of 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

FOUR! Make that three boundaries on the trot! Fourth off the over and Tamim Iqbal is taking the attack to South Africa here! Another short ball, around leg. Tamim swivels and pulls it along the ground through the fine leg region. Tabraiz Shamsi there, runs to his right, puts in a dive but to no avail.

FOUR! BANG! Third boundary off the over! The skipper means business! Rabada serves a short ball, around middle. Tamim Iqbal stands tall and pulls it in front square on the leg side for another boundary.
FOUR! Even better from Tamim Iqbal! Back of a length, around leg and cramping the batter for room. Tamim hangs back, swivels and just helps it on its way behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Tamim Iqbal pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is a good-length delivery, around off. Tamim Iqbal sits back, gets inside the line of the ball and caresses it through the point region for a boundary. Lovely batting!
A length ball, angling across the batter from outside off. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone.
Another ball that is a bit shorter in length, outside off. Liton Das rocks back and cuts hard but finds the point fielder yet again. 6 runs off the over!
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Liton Das mistimes his cut shot towards the point fielder.
Flighted delivery, on a length, around middle. Tamim Iqbal looks to paddle it through fine leg. He gets hit on his glove and the ball lobs up behind square on the leg side. The batters cross ends.
FOUR! Top shot from the skipper! This is tossed up, well outside off. Tamim kneels, gets to the pitch of the ball and sweeps it behind square on the leg side. The ball races away to the fence.
Floated, full and around off. Tamim gets forward and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, outside off. Liton Das prods and works it to long off for a single.
Good-length ball, angling in from off. Tamim keeps it out, off the front foot.
Ngidi sees Tamim advancing down the track so he serves a slower ball, into the surface. Tamim manages to dab it towards backward point in the end.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Tamim Iqbal and this time he was in complete control! On a length, around the fifth stump channel. Tamim leans and carves it past the cover fielder to bag a boundary.
FOUR! Edgy! This is a good-length delivery, just outside off. Tamim prods and has a poke at it. It takes the outside edge and flies past the first slip fielder for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Tamim Iqbal punches it towards cover.
Full and outside off. Tamim Iqbal mistimes his off drive wide of the mid off fielder. No run there as the fielder cuts it off.
FOUR! Slightly short and Das pounces on it! Das rocks back to this short ball, around off and cuts it hard through the point region for a boundary.
A bit quicker this time, on a length, around off. Das looks to defend but hits the splice of his bat and goes towards cover.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Das blocks it off the front foot.
Another tossed up delivery, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans and works it towards long on for a single.
A loopy ball, full and outside off. Tamim Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out.
Tosses it up, outside off. Tamim flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Keshav Maharaj is into the attack.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Das gets forward and blocks it to the off side.
Full and around middle. Das drives it to the mid on fielder.
Good-length ball, around off. Liton Das hangs back to block but he misses and gets hit on his pad yet again. The South Africans do not appeal this time as the ball was going way down leg.
A slower ball, into the surface, around off. Das looks to pull but the ball keeps low and almost knocks his off pole over.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A gift from Ngidi, a half-volley, just outside off. Das prods and drives it back past the bowler, through mid off for a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A full ball, jagging back in from middle. Liton Das misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. Might have gone down leg though!
Five consecutive dots to end the over! This was on a length and on off, driven to mid off.
Around off, on a length. Iqbal lunges and strokes it to covers.
Length and on off. Iqbal defends under his eyes.
Touch short, on off. Iqbal hops and knocks it to point.
Pitches it up, on off. Iqbal defends it to mid off.
FOUR! That came off the middle of the bat! Short in length, outside off. Iqbal hangs back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Dot to end the over! A length ball, angling around middle and leg. Liton steps across inside his crease and keeps it out.
Beautiful shot but the South African skipper does well to cut it off! A length ball, outside off. Das leans and caresses it through covers. Bavuma chases and keeps it down to two.
Touch fuller and on off, driven to the left of mid off for a quick single.
Almost chopped on! Length ball, angling around off. Iqbal is a touch late as he looks to push and the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on the boot.
Keeps it around off. Iqbal is happy to nudge it to mid off.
Length ball, on off. Tamim with a full face of the bat, defends it.
FOUR! Boundary just kills of what could have been a good over for South Africa. A length ball, outside off. Das plays with soft hands as he guides it through point for a boundary. Good shot.
Length ball, outside off, this is hit to point. Make it five dots.
Four dots in a row! Length and slanting around middle, it is nudged to mid-wicket.
Around off. Das plays it late and to point. No run. Good bowling from Rabada.
Length and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Beaten! A length ball, just around off, angles a bit in and nips away off the seam. Das tries to defend inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Around off, on a length. Iqbal knocks it to covers.

FOUR! First boundary off the chase comes from the blade of Iqbal! Not the best of shots from him as he almost chopped it on. A length ball, outside off, extra bounce there. Iqbal looks to punch but it goes off the inside edge to the fine leg fence.
Length ball, angling across, outside off. Iqbal shoulders arms to it.
Length and on middle. Iqbal steps across and keeps it out.
Fuller and on off. Das drives it off the front foot, to the left of covers and the batters take a quick single.
Length and outside off. Liton punches it to point.
Who will bowl from the other end? Lungi Ngidi it is.
Length ball, around off. Iqbal prods and defends this out. An eventful over from Rabada comes to an end.
Short in length, around off. Iqbal blocks it to point.
Wide! Length and way outside off. Iqbal shoulders arms to it.

Dropped! A low target to defend and this has to be taken! A length ball, width offered, outside off. Das cuts it aerially and straight to point where Keshav Maharaj lets it through his hands. Was at a good height as well. A single is taken.
Touch fuller this time, on middle. Das drops it to mid off.
Length ball, straight on middle. Das tucks it to mid-wicket.
Bangladesh and Iqbal are underway! A length ball, on middle. Iqbal nudges it to square leg for a single.
